edits.before: Level 3 is the lane's inflection point: the moment Galio gets Shield of Durand he can channel through your E-taunt and reduce a meaningful chunk of your Q-empowered auto burst. Do not run the full E-W-Q combo into a Galio who is ready to W — bait the Shield first, let its cooldown run, THEN Shadow Dash and trade. Level 6 introduces the global cat-and-mouse: his Hero's Entrance can answer your Stand United on the same fight, so choose R targets in fights across the map that are physically beyond his cast range, or time your channel in the moment he has just R'd somewhere else.
edits.after: Level 3 is the lane's inflection point: the moment Galio gets Shield of Durand he can hold the channel through your Shadow Dash taunt and cut your Q-empowered auto burst. Do not run the full E-W-Q into a Galio holding W — bait it out, ride the 16s cooldown at rank 1, THEN dash and trade. Level 6 is a global race you lose on paper: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140s against Stand United's 200/180/160s, and it reaches only 4000/4750/5500 units. Win it on geography — spend Stand United on fights outside that radius, or in the window right after he has spent his.
